subject: Oakridge BCP onboarding — RTO/RPO evidence sequencing
messages:
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@oakridgefin.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: James Liu <james.liu@oakridgefin.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T07:21:00-07:00
Subject: Oakridge vendor intake — RTO/RPO evidence request

Hi Irene,

Thanks for picking this up. As part of our vendor resilience intake for Oakridge Financial we need a compact evidence packet that demonstrates Redwood's declared RTO/RPO across the hosted API and dedicated deployment modes. Specifically we are asking for:

- A matrix that maps service components (API ingestion, KV cache restore, model serving pool warm-up) to observed RTOs and RPOs under your standard warm-standby scenario.
- Representative traces or CSVs showing a recent test (within 90 days) with timestamps for failover start and application availability.
- The runbook excerpt that defines the sequence for keystore rotation and cache rehydration.

We also want to schedule a 45-minute live witness where our ops team watches a short replay (or simulated) failover and validates timings. Can you confirm availability the week of Apr 26 (PT)?

If you can attach the matrix and any CSV samples to your reply that will help our review. We aim to close this intake by May 3.

Best,
Olivia Barnes
Head of Vendor Risk — Oakridge Financial
olivia.barnes@oakridgefin.com
+1 415-555-0123
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@oakridgefin.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Oakridge vendor intake — RTO/RPO evidence request

Hi Olivia — thanks for the clear ask. We're prepared to provide a compact package and a live witness. Quick plan: 

1) Attached: oakridge_bcp_matrix_v1.xlsx (component -> RTO/RPO table with notes).
2) We'll attach a CSV slice of a recent warm-standby replay (rto_rpo-snapshots-20270421.csv) capturing failover start, KV rehydrate complete, and service OK.
3) We'll include a runbook extract (runbook-extracts.pdf) showing keystore rotation and cache hydration steps.

For the witness: we can run a simulated warm-standby activation and provide telemetry for the times you listed. Ben will be the technical lead on the replay and Marissa will provide the attestation language you asked for. 

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Apr 27 13:00–13:45
- Wed Apr 28 09:00–09:45

Can you confirm which works for your team and whether you prefer a live replay or a recorded run + live Q&A?

Attaching the matrix now. I'll follow up with the CSV and runbook extracts in a separate message (large files).

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Director, Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
From: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@oakridgefin.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: James Liu <james.liu@oakridgefin.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T10:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Oakridge vendor intake — RTO/RPO evidence request

Thanks Irene — Tue Apr 27 13:00 PT works for us. A couple clarifications before the witness:

- For the CSV traces: can you include UTC timestamps (ISO) and a short column describing the event (e.g., "kv_rehydrate_complete")?
- We need to confirm the scope of the replay: is keystore rotation part of the warm-standby replay or will it be a separate demo?

Prefer live replay if possible; our compliance team will want to observe telemetry in real time.

Regards,
Olivia

---
Olivia Barnes
Head of Vendor Risk — Oakridge Financial
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@oakridgefin.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Oakridge vendor intake — RTO/RPO evidence request

On Fri, Apr 23, 2027 at 10:15 AM Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@oakridgefin.com> wrote:
> Thanks Irene — Tue Apr 27 13:00 PT works for us. A couple clarifications before the witness:
> 
> - For the CSV traces: can you include UTC timestamps (ISO) and a short column describing the event (e.g., "kv_rehydrate_complete")?
> - We need to confirm the scope of the replay: is keystore rotation part of the warm-standby replay or will it be a separate demo?

Hi Olivia — Ben here. Short answers: yes, we'll normalize all timestamps to ISO-8601 (UTC) and add an "event_label" column. Keystore rotation will be demonstrated as a separate step in the replay sequence (we'll show it immediately following KV rehydration).

I've attached the CSV slice (rto_rpo-snapshots-20270421.csv) and a PDF with the runbook excerpts (runbook-extracts.pdf). For the witness we propose the following test plan:

- 00:00 — trigger warm-standby activation (failover start)
- 00:45 — KV cache rehydrate begins (samples show ~45–75s rehydrate in our tests)
- 02:10 — keystore rotation demo (non-blocking, verified via audit log)
- 03:30 — API ingress checks green (end-to-end traffic at nominal load)

Please note these times are for our representative replay (21 Apr test) and will vary by model sequence length and load. For the live witness we'll run at nominal traffic and capture the same telemetry.

Attachments: rto_rpo-snapshots-20270421.csv (CSV slice), runbook-extracts.pdf (excerpts).

If that's good we'll lock Tue Apr 27 13:00 PT and send a calendar invite with dial-in + recording permission.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: rto_rpo-snapshots-20270421.csv (CSV, 120KB); runbook-extracts.pdf (PDF, 240KB)
From: James Liu <james.liu@oakridgefin.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia.barnes@oakridgefin.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-27T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Oakridge vendor intake — RTO/RPO evidence request

Hi Ben / team — confirmed for Tue Apr 27 13:00 PT (we have the invite). Two quick clarifications for the intake packet: 

1) In the CSV sample, can you add a column "test_id" (so we can map events back to the test run id)?
2) For the keystore rotation step please confirm whether the rotation will write an entry to the audit log within 30s of rotation completion (we need that for our control mapping).

If you can drop an updated CSV with those columns before the session that would be great. Looking forward to the replay.

Thanks,
James Liu
Senior Manager, Third-Party Risk — Oakridge Financial
